clue.text: Changes to some hampers needing adjustment

indicators.note: letters that need adjusting are to be put into a new order, so the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone notices that a few picnic baskets need some alterations made to them.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun synonym: transformations from one form into another are changes.

clue.text: Enchanting note about silver state

indicators.note: the note goes around the chemical symbol, so one sits about the other

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
Cal is a short form for California, a US state

explanation.surface: A musical note about a silvery state is described as enchanting.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective synonym: something enchanting casts a spell, seeming to work by sorcery.

clue.text: Agrees to accept one of the French to show support

indicators.note: the pair of words takes in a further piece between them, accepting it inside

parts.note: to take an offer is to agree to it
des is French for 'of the' before a plural
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to welcome a French person as a gesture of solidarity.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to back one party in a dispute is to show it support.

clue.text: Spread stuff turning up on empty grave

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to stuff or cram is to ram

indicators.note: an empty word keeps only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A spread of something is turned over onto an opened grave.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for margarine, a spread for bread used in place of butter.

clue.text: This girl sees beads take me back

indicators.note: the string of beads takes in the reversed pronoun, holding it inside

parts.note: a rosary is a string of prayer beads

indicators.note: back means the little word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A girl looks at a string of beads and is reminded of her past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sees' is only a link; 'back' reverses ME, and 'take' means the beads hold it.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a girl's name, so the clue's 'This girl' is one named so.

clue.text: Herald could be male, taken in by endless heterodoxy

indicators.note: the letter for male is held inside the shortened word
endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: heterodoxy, belief against the orthodox, is heresy

explanation.surface: A messenger, perhaps a man, is drawn in by a dissenting doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts HERESY to HERES, which takes in M. 'could be' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Proper name: in Greek myth he is the messenger of the gods, their herald.

clue.text: Present on board to soldier at sea in such weather

indicators.note: being on board a steamship is being inside the letters that stand for it

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the ship one is on board
the present is now
taken as written
RM, Royal Marine, is a soldier serving at sea

explanation.surface: A gift is handed to a soldier on a ship during a wintry squall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the convention for going inside SS (steamship).
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a blizzard is a kind of weather, the clue's 'such weather'.

clue.text: Instrument of rising bureaucratisation?

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters are read upwards, in reverse
of means the letters are taken from within the long word

explanation.surface: A wry question asks what tool would serve increasing red tape.
explanation.walkthrough: RATIS sits inside 'bureaucratisation'; 'rising' turns it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a long-necked Indian lute is a stringed musical instrument.

clue.text: Wrongly accused, and prepared to hang

definitions.meaning: set up by false evidence so as to look guilty
a picture put in a mount ready for the wall

explanation.surface: Someone innocent is charged and readied for the gallows.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: set up by false evidence, and mounted ready for display on a wall.

clue.text: Reasonable skills shown by good little racers

indicators.note: the reasonable skills are displayed next to the good, which leads them

parts.note: something reasonable is OK
arts are skills or crafts

explanation.surface: Decent ability is displayed by some well-behaved young runners.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: small open motor vehicles raced on tracks are little racers.

clue.text: Thatcher perhaps needing way to replace loud morning caller

indicators.note: the abbreviation for way takes the place of the musical letter for loud

parts.note: a thatcher is one kind of roofer, hence 'perhaps'
f, forte, is the musical direction for loud
St, street, is a way

explanation.surface: Mrs Thatcher seems to need a route around a noisy early visitor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thatcher' suggests Margaret Thatcher, but it is a roof-thatching trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: a cockerel crows at dawn, so calls in the morning.

clue.text: Social status of Conservative having lost seat

indicators.note: a lost word is one gone astray, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Tory MP loses a parliamentary seat and with it a social standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a hereditary class in a society fixes one's social rank.

clue.text: Confusion of line adopted by virtuoso beginning to moralise

indicators.note: the line is taken in, placed within the word for virtuoso

parts.note: a maestro is a virtuoso performer

indicators.note: beginning means the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A line taken by a master performer leaves everyone confused when he starts preaching.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative sense: a whirlpool, hence any scene of turbulent confusion.

clue.text: Bug woman and attempt to stifle resistance

parts.note: a lady is a woman

indicators.note: to stifle is to smother, so the letter is held within the word for attempt

parts.note: a bid is an attempt
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A woman tries to suppress opposition while being annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a spotted beetle is an insect, which loosely is a bug.

clue.text: Radar Cuba developed for predatory type

indicators.note: something developed has been worked into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Radar technology built in Cuba is designed to track a hunter.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a large toothy fish that hunts prey is a predatory type.

clue.text: Bizarrely, the body, with no end of dairy, becomes a breeding ground

indicators.note: bizarrely signals the letters are set in a strange new order
with no means the letter is taken away from the word before it
end of means the last letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Oddly, a body without dairy food turns into a place where things breed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of dairy' drops Y from BODY; 'Bizarrely' rearranges THE BOD.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a warm bed of manure for seedlings, hence any place where something thrives.

clue.text: Make a mess of stories about female insects

indicators.note: the stories come about, alongside, the letter for female, which leads them

parts.note: to blow it is to make a mess of it
lies are untrue stories

explanation.surface: Someone ruins tales concerning a woman's bugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the bluebottle and other carrion flies are insects.

clue.text: Caught two swimmers and a crustacean

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a ray and a fish, two creatures that swim

explanation.surface: An angler lands two fish and a shellfish too.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a freshwater lobster-like creature is a crustacean.

clue.text: Desire must come before soldiers shine

indicators.note: the word for desire is placed ahead of the soldiers

parts.note: lust is strong desire
RE, Royal Engineers, are soldiers

explanation.surface: Passion is put ahead of the troops' polishing of boots.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun synonym: gloss or sheen on a surface is its shine.

clue.text: Ambassador's attendance in support of the French

definitions.note: read as 'Ambassador is', the noun stands for the answer

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below the one it holds up

parts.note: le is a French word for 'the'
the gate at a match is the number attending

explanation.surface: A diplomat's turnout backs the French delegation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a papal envoy or representative abroad is an ambassador.

clue.text: Sort of writing about border flower

indicators.note: the sort of writing goes around the border, which sits inside

parts.note: prose is a kind of writing, not verse
a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A gardener writes a piece about a flower in the herbaceous border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'border' looks like a garden bed, but it means an edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pale yellow spring bloom is a flower.

clue.text: Spain joined and came out

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain
merged means joined together

explanation.surface: Spain signed up to an alliance and then went public.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something that appeared or surfaced has come out.

clue.text: Wants to have formal agreements with granny gone

indicators.note: gone means the word for granny is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: covenants are formal agreements
nan is a familiar word for granny

explanation.surface: Someone wishes to sign contracts now that their grandmother has died.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to crave something belonging to another is to want it.

clue.text: Returning desire for example to include a record study of trees

indicators.note: the reversed pair takes in the next pieces, holding them inside
returning means the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: a yen is a longing or desire
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A longing to return, for instance, prompts a botanical record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returning' turns YEN EG into GENEY, which takes in A LOG. 'trees' are family trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic angle: the study of family lineage draws up family trees.

clue.text: Currency held by authoritarians on the rise

indicators.note: in a down clue, on the rise means the letters are read upwards
held by means the letters are found inside the following word

explanation.surface: Money is controlled by dictators whose power is growing.
explanation.walkthrough: ARIAN sits inside 'authoritarians'; 'on the rise' turns it upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the official money of Nigeria is a currency.

clue.text: One runs from animal in Africa — mistake!

indicators.note: the letters run off from the animal, so they are removed

parts.note: a giraffe is an African animal
I is the Roman numeral for one
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Someone flees a wild beast on safari, and it was an error!
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a social blunder or embarrassing slip is a mistake.

clue.text: Suggestion from good master of ceremonies

parts.note: a host presides like a master of ceremonies

explanation.surface: A fine compère offers a proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a faint trace, as in a hint of a smile, is a suggestion.

clue.text: Praise from extended family embracing Utah

indicators.note: embracing means holding the state's abbreviation inside

parts.note: a tribe is an extended family group
UT is the postal abbreviation for Utah

explanation.surface: Relatives warmly hug a Utah relation and lavish compliments.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an act or speech of homage and praise.

clue.text: I call around on pressing business

indicators.note: the call goes around the little word, which sits inside

parts.note: to ring is to call by phone

explanation.surface: I telephone about some urgent matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pressing business' sounds urgent, but it means pressing clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: smoothing clothes with a hot iron is literally a business of pressing.

clue.text: Put under the sea instead, after a redesign

indicators.note: a redesign remakes something in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is plunged into the ocean, as a revised plan demands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redesign' rearranges THE SEA INSTEAD; 'after a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a patient put under is made unconscious for surgery.
